entities.summary: The Old Yishuv Court Museum is an ethnographic museum on Or HaHaim Street in the Jewish Quarter of the Old City of Jerusalem. It showcases the traditional lifestyle of the Jewish Old Yishuv community during the late Ottoman and Mandatory periods, leading up to the fall of the Jewish Quarter to the Jordanian army in the 1948 Palestine war.
